name: Triaxos
storyline: A mind probe has been sent to the maximum security prison Triaxos to obtain information from a prisoner who is the only man capable of activating the most powerful weapon in the galaxy. You landed at the prison 10 minutes before the probe to find the man and bring him back to your ship within 30 minutes. You have to search the prison, blow up the robot guards and explore every room.
summary: Triaxos is a flickscreen arcade adventure with an isometric view. In addition to the main game area, you can also see your energy bars, number of charges, score and a timer counting down to zero. There are also two maps, one of the entire prison and one of the room, showing all the hidden exits and items on the walls.
